Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.

19	# 论文写作风格规范
20	
21	> 核心哲学：**论文是一个有说服力的故事，不是实验报告。** 审稿人在几十秒内判断论文价值——如果 Abstract 和 Introduction 读起来像实验日志，论文就已经失败了。
22	
23	---
24	
25	## 一、总体写作哲学
26	
27	### 1.1 故事驱动，不是数据堆砌
28	
29	- 论文必须以"故事线"为核心展开：问题 → 洞察 → 方法 → 验证
30	- 禁止大量实验数据堆砌——每个数字出现必须服务于叙事推进
31	- 附录内容必须在正文中有明确引用且融入叙事，禁止简单堆砌
32	- 如果附录数据对核心叙事有重大影响，根据附录数据调整论文 framing
33	
34	### 1.2 主线统一性
35	
36	- 当 idea 在研究过程中发生变化后，**必须重审全文逻辑**
37	- 常见问题：Introduction 讲的故事 A，Method 做的是故事 B，Results 又在讲故事 C
38	- 修复方式：从最终实验结论反推，重写 Introduction 的问题定义和动机
39	- 每次 idea 调整后检查：Abstract → Introduction → Method → Results → Discussion → Conclusion 是否形成一条连贯主线
40	
41	### 1.3 专有名词必须有定义
42	
43	- 首次出现的专有名词/缩写必须给出完整定义和解释
44	- Abstract 中使用的缩写也必须在 Abstract 内定义（如 LLM = Large Language Model）
45	- 不能假设读者知道你自己定义的术语——论文从来没解释过的概念不能直接使用
46	- 通用规则：如果一个非标准术语第一次出现时没有括号定义，就是写作 bug
47	
48	### 1.4 写作前必读同类优秀论文
49	
50	- 每个章节动笔前，找 **2-3 篇目标会议近 1-2 年的高分论文**作为风格参考——同类问题或同类方法皆可
51	- 重点学：
52	  - Abstract 怎么用最少篇幅讲完故事
53	  - Introduction 怎么从大问题切入到具体贡献
54	  - Related Work 怎么 positioning 自己（不是 survey）
55	  - Table/Figure 怎么压缩信息密度
56	- **不是抄袭**，是学习同行的故事节奏和审美——不同子领域叙事节奏差异很大
57	- 实操：Paper Agent 可以从 `literature_map.yaml` 中挑 `role=foundation` 或 `role=direct-competitor` 的论文，把 `{title, venue, year, abstract}` 附在 Worker 的 task_prompt 中作为概念参考；如需学习写作风格本身，让 Worker 通过 WebSearch 取得论文链接并 fetch 全文
58	
59	---
60	
61	## 二、Abstract 写作规范
62	
63	### 2.1 四个必答问题（150-250 words）
64	
65	Abstract 必须在很短的篇幅内清楚回答：
66	1. **研究什么问题** — 1-2 句话交代背景和痛点
67	2. **为什么重要** — 现有方法的不足（不用写太多）
68	3. **本文提出什么** — 核心贡献的关键机制（简要，不堆砌细节）
69	4. **结果说明什么** — 用具体实验结论支撑贡献
70	
71	### 2.2 禁忌
72	
73	- **禁止堆砌数据**：Abstract 不是 Results 的缩写。最多引用 2-3 个关键数字，要服务于 claim
74	- **禁止过度宣传**：不说 "revolutionary"、"groundbreaking"
75	- **禁止写成 Introduction 的缩写**：Abstract 是独立阅读单元
76	- **禁止术语堆积**：如果审稿人几十秒内判断不出价值，就失败了
77	- **缩写必须定义**：Abstract 中首次出现的缩写必须展开
78	
79	### 2.3 审稿人视角检验
80	
81	写完后用这个标准自检：审稿人能否在 30 秒内判断——
82	- 问题是否重要？
83	- 方法是否清楚？
84	- 贡献是否可信？
85	- 结果是否有说服力？
86	
87	---
88	
89	## 三、Introduction 写作规范
90	
91	### 3.1 完整叙事线（5 段结构）
92	
93	Introduction 需要从一个清晰、重要的问题切入，逐步把读者带到核心贡献：
94	
95	1. **研究背景**（1-2 段）：大模型在某类能力/应用中已取得进展，但仍存在一个关键瓶颈
96	2. **问题重要性**（1 段）：结合真实应用、已有方法局限或当前趋势，说明这不是小问题
97	3. **现有方法不足**（1 段）：系统梳理为什么不够（依赖更大模型/更多数据/更复杂推理/更高成本，或只在特定 benchmark 有效）
98	4. **本文核心想法**（1 段）：我们观察到什么、提出了什么方法、为什么能解决上述问题
99	5. **贡献总结**（列表）：清楚列出方法贡献、实验贡献和分析贡献
100	
101	### 3.2 整体叙事结构
102	
103	```
104	现有进展 → 关键缺口 → 本文洞察 → 方法概述 → 实验证据 → 贡献总结
105	```
106	
107	### 3.3 禁忌
108	
109	- **禁止泛泛介绍**：不要开头就写 "LLMs have shown remarkable capabilities..."，要从具体问题切入
110	- **禁止缺少过渡**：每段之间必须有逻辑连接
111	- **禁止实验报告风格**：Introduction 不是 "我们做了 X 实验得到了 Y 结果" 的罗列
112	- 每条 Contribution 必须有对应的 section/table 支撑
113	- Contribution 列表中不能出现未在前文铺垫过的概念
114	
115	---
116	
117	## 四、Related Work 写作规范
118	
119	### 4.1 目标
120	
121	让审稿人相信：作者理解这个领域，知道自己的方法站在什么位置，清楚相对已有工作的真实增量在哪里。
122	
123	### 4.2 结构要求
124	
125	- 把已有工作分成几个清晰的主题（如模型训练、推理增强、工具调用、数据构建、评测等）
126	- 每类简要说明：已有方法做了什么、解决了哪些问题、和本文的关系
127	- 帮助读者理解：哪些是本文直接继承的，哪些方法不同但解决相似问题，哪些留下了本文要解决的缺口
128	
129	### 4.3 禁忌
130	
131	- **禁止论文堆砌**：不要写成 "A proposed X. B proposed Y. C proposed Z." 的列表
132	- **目标不是展示读了多少论文**，而是做归纳和比较
133	- Contribution claim（"To our knowledge, no prior work..."）应放在 Introduction，不在 Related Work
134	
135	### 4.4 引用充足度
136	
137	- 引用必须覆盖：**直接相关方法、baseline 论文、评测 benchmark 论文、理论基础**
138	- 任何一类缺失，审稿人会立刻看出来调研不充分
139	- 引用密度参照目标会议近年录用论文的量级——明显偏少意味着 Related Work 调研不足
140	
141	---
142	
143	## 五、去 AI 写作风格（硬规则）
144	
145	以下模式是 AI 生成文本的典型标志，审稿人一眼能看出。**必须全部消除。**
146	
147	### 5.1 严禁破折号（最显著的 AI 痕迹）
148	
149	**这是 AI 写作最容易被识别的标志，审稿人最敏感。单列为最高优先级硬规则。**
150	
151	- 解释性 em-dash（—，U+2014）和 en-dash（–，U+2013）必须**全部删除**

159	
160	### 5.2 段落与句式
161	
162	- **禁止过度分段**：不需要每 2-3 句就换段，自然段 5-8 句是正常的

166	- **避免 "It is worth noting that..." / "Notably, ..."**：直接写要说的内容

169	
170	- 避免 "delve into" / "leverage" / "utilize" / "facilitate" — 用 "explore" / "use" / "enable"

172	- 避免 "in the realm of" / "in the context of" — 直接说
173	- 避免 "paradigm shift" / "novel" 过度使用

177	1. 全文 proofread 语法和拼写
178	2. 检查所有代词/指示词（this, that, it）是否指代明确

183	
184	## 六、图表与视觉规范
185	
186	### 6.1 知识密度原则
187	
188	- **图表的信息必须紧凑**——不能为了美观而留大量白空间

191	
192	### 6.2 表格规范
193	
194	- 表格和正文文字不能视觉重叠（检查 column 宽度和 alignment）

196	- 最优加粗、次优下划线
197	- Caption 必须自包含
198

200

203	- 栏宽约束需匹配目标 venue 模板要求
204	- 概念图/流程图要有信息量，不要画一个 trivial 的 pipeline 然后占半页
205

207	
208	- 顶会正文页数严格受限（具体页数查目标会议官网），每 cm² 都是宝贵资源
209	- 优先使用 `\subfigure` 合并相关图
210	- Table 能 inline 就不要单独浮动
211	- 图表占比与其对叙事的贡献成正比
212	
213	### 6.5 页面节奏
214	
215	好论文的页面有节奏感——text、equation、figure 交替出现，读者视觉不疲劳：
216	
217	- **text-equation-figure 三重奏**：重要概念用"文字解释 → 公式定义 → 图表直觉"三步展开
218	- 连续 2 页纯文本（无 figure/equation/table）→ 穿插一个 display item 打破节奏

222	
223	### 6.6 表格 LaTeX 规范
224	
225	**Booktabs 标准（硬规则）**：
226	- 用 `\toprule` / `\midrule` / `\bottomrule`，禁止 `\hline`，禁止竖线 `|`
227	- 用 `\centering` 不用 `\begin{center}`（后者多加垂直空白）

229	- 小数精度全表统一（如全部保留 1 位或 2 位）
230	- Caption 在表格上方（`\caption` 在 `\begin{tabular}` 之前）
231

236	
237	---
238	
239	## 七、投稿前通用准备

241	### 7.1 模板必须官方（硬规则）
242	
243	- LaTeX 模板**必须从目标会议官网下载**（CallForPapers / Author Instructions 页面）

251	  - reference 格式错 → 被认为不规范
252	- 流程：先查会议官网 templates → 找不到再 `WebSearch "{venue} {year} latex template official"` → 仍找不到汇报 Director（不要用就近年版本顶替）

# 论文写作风格规范

> 核心哲学：**论文是一个有说服力的故事，不是实验报告。** 审稿人在几十秒内判断论文价值——如果 Abstract 和 Introduction 读起来像实验日志，论文就已经失败了。

---

## 一、总体写作哲学

### 1.1 故事驱动，不是数据堆砌

- 论文必须以"故事线"为核心展开：问题 → 洞察 → 方法 → 验证
- 禁止大量实验数据堆砌——每个数字出现必须服务于叙事推进
- 附录内容必须在正文中有明确引用且融入叙事，禁止简单堆砌
- 如果附录数据对核心叙事有重大影响，根据附录数据调整论文 framing

### 1.2 主线统一性

- 当 idea 在研究过程中发生变化后，**必须重审全文逻辑**
- 常见问题：Introduction 讲的故事 A，Method 做的是故事 B，Results 又在讲故事 C
- 修复方式：从最终实验结论反推，重写 Introduction 的问题定义和动机
- 每次 idea 调整后检查：Abstract → Introduction → Method → Results → Discussion → Conclusion 是否形成一条连贯主线

### 1.3 专有名词必须有定义

- 首次出现的专有名词/缩写必须给出完整定义和解释
- Abstract 中使用的缩写也必须在 Abstract 内定义（如 LLM = Large Language Model）
- 不能假设读者知道你自己定义的术语——论文从来没解释过的概念不能直接使用
- 通用规则：如果一个非标准术语第一次出现时没有括号定义，就是写作 bug

### 1.4 写作前必读同类优秀论文

- 每个章节动笔前，找 **2-3 篇目标会议近 1-2 年的高分论文**作为风格参考——同类问题或同类方法皆可
- 重点学：
  - Abstract 怎么用最少篇幅讲完故事
  - Introduction 怎么从大问题切入到具体贡献
  - Related Work 怎么 positioning 自己（不是 survey）
  - Table/Figure 怎么压缩信息密度
- **不是抄袭**，是学习同行的故事节奏和审美——不同子领域叙事节奏差异很大
- 实操：Paper Agent 可以从 `literature_map.yaml` 中挑 `role=foundation` 或 `role=direct-competitor` 的论文，把 `{title, venue, year, abstract}` 附在 Worker 的 task_prompt 中作为概念参考；如需学习写作风格本身，让 Worker 通过 WebSearch 取得论文链接并 fetch 全文

---

## 二、Abstract 写作规范

### 2.1 四个必答问题（150-250 words）

Abstract 必须在很短的篇幅内清楚回答：
1. **研究什么问题** — 1-2 句话交代背景和痛点
2. **为什么重要** — 现有方法的不足（不用写太多）
3. **本文提出什么** — 核心贡献的关键机制（简要，不堆砌细节）
4. **结果说明什么** — 用具体实验结论支撑贡献

### 2.2 禁忌

- **禁止堆砌数据**：Abstract 不是 Results 的缩写。最多引用 2-3 个关键数字，要服务于 claim
- **禁止过度宣传**：不说 "revolutionary"、"groundbreaking"
- **禁止写成 Introduction 的缩写**：Abstract 是独立阅读单元
- **禁止术语堆积**：如果审稿人几十秒内判断不出价值，就失败了
- **缩写必须定义**：Abstract 中首次出现的缩写必须展开

### 2.3 审稿人视角检验

写完后用这个标准自检：审稿人能否在 30 秒内判断——
- 问题是否重要？
- 方法是否清楚？
- 贡献是否可信？
- 结果是否有说服力？

---

## 三、Introduction 写作规范

### 3.1 完整叙事线（5 段结构）

Introduction 需要从一个清晰、重要的问题切入，逐步把读者带到核心贡献：

1. **研究背景**（1-2 段）：大模型在某类能力/应用中已取得进展，但仍存在一个关键瓶颈
2. **问题重要性**（1 段）：结合真实应用、已有方法局限或当前趋势，说明这不是小问题
3. **现有方法不足**（1 段）：系统梳理为什么不够（依赖更大模型/更多数据/更复杂推理/更高成本，或只在特定 benchmark 有效）
4. **本文核心想法**（1 段）：我们观察到什么、提出了什么方法、为什么能解决上述问题
5. **贡献总结**（列表）：清楚列出方法贡献、实验贡献和分析贡献

### 3.2 整体叙事结构

```
现有进展 → 关键缺口 → 本文洞察 → 方法概述 → 实验证据 → 贡献总结
```

### 3.3 禁忌

- **禁止泛泛介绍**：不要开头就写 "LLMs have shown remarkable capabilities..."，要从具体问题切入
- **禁止缺少过渡**：每段之间必须有逻辑连接
- **禁止实验报告风格**：Introduction 不是 "我们做了 X 实验得到了 Y 结果" 的罗列
- 每条 Contribution 必须有对应的 section/table 支撑
- Contribution 列表中不能出现未在前文铺垫过的概念

---

### 4.1 目标

### 4.2 结构要求

- 把已有工作分成几个清晰的主题（如模型训练、推理增强、工具调用、数据构建、评测等）
- 每类简要说明：已有方法做了什么、解决了哪些问题、和本文的关系
- 帮助读者理解：哪些是本文直接继承的，哪些方法不同但解决相似问题，哪些留下了本文要解决的缺口

### 4.3 禁忌

- **禁止论文堆砌**：不要写成 "A proposed X. B proposed Y. C proposed Z." 的列表
- **目标不是展示读了多少论文**，而是做归纳和比较
- Contribution claim（"To our knowledge, no prior work..."）应放在 Introduction，不在 Related Work

### 4.4 引用充足度

- 引用必须覆盖：**直接相关方法、baseline 论文、评测 benchmark 论文、理论基础**
- 任何一类缺失，审稿人会立刻看出来调研不充分
- 引用密度参照目标会议近年录用论文的量级——明显偏少意味着 Related Work 调研不足

- 流程：先查会议官网 templates → 找不到再 `WebSearch "{venue} {year} latex template official"` → 仍找不到汇报 Director（不要用就近年版本顶替）
- `\documentclass[]{}` 选项必须与目标 venue + 阶段（review / camera-ready）一致

### 7.2 投稿要求逐项核对

- 目标会议如要求 Checklist / Ethical Statement / Broader Impact Statement / Reproducibility Statement，必须**认真填每一项**，不要全写 N/A
- 页数限制：查目标会议官网
- 匿名化要求：review 版 vs camera-ready 版本设置不同
- 行号开启（review 版常需）
- 字体大小、margin 不得修改 sty 文件

### 7.3 最终修改 10 项检查流程

提交前必须逐一检查：
1. 所有最新实验结果已全部录入
2. 根据实验结果将叙事调至最优状态
3. 附录所有内容在正文中被引用且融入叙事
4. 无数据堆砌（每个数字服务于叙事推进）
5. Abstract 和 Introduction 具有吸引力（不是实验报告风格）
6. 全文主线统一（idea 变化后各章节逻辑一致）
7. 所有专有名词有定义
8. 无 AI 风格标志（dash、-ing phrases、过度分段）
9. 图表知识密度高、无视觉遮挡
10. Reference 覆盖直接相关方法、baseline、benchmark、理论基础

39	
40	- 配对数据必须同 seed、同 c 值、同 N、同 evaluation protocol

48	
49	- 被 Director shelved 的数据（如因截断混淆），禁止重新引入论文
50	- `paper_provenance.yaml` 中 `verified: false` 的 claim，不得恢复

56	
57	### 2.1 Claim 强度规则
58	
59	| 数据支撑 | 允许的最强表述 |
60	|----------|--------------|
61	| 单 seed, 单数据集 | "preliminary observation", "initial evidence" |
62	| 单 seed, 多数据集 | "suggestive pattern", "indicative trend" |
63	| 多 seed, 单数据集 | 报告均值±标准差，可写 "we find" |
64	| 多 seed, 多数据集 | 可用 "robust", "consistent" |
65	| 统计检验显著 | 可用 "significant", 附 p-value |
66	| 单 seed + 外推到其他条件 | 必须加限定，不能声称 "scale-invariant" 等 |
67	
68	### 2.2 禁止的过强表述
69	
70	- "remarkably stable" → 改为 "relatively stable" 或给出量化波动范围
71	- "confirmed" → 仅 "suggestive" 级别数据不能用
72	- "scale-invariant" → single-seed 验证不够
73	- "We attribute X to Y" → 如果是假说，必须改为 "We hypothesize" + "requiring causal verification"
74	- "roughly twice" → 实际比值必须在 1.8x-2.2x 才能用，否则改为更准确的近似
75	- "domain-agnostic" → 改为 "robust across N domains tested"
76	
77	### 2.3 Claim 降级机制
78	
79	当证据不足以支撑独立 claim 时，应降级为 discussion 中的定性讨论，而非删除。具体做法：
80	- 独立 contribution → Discussion 段落
81	- 硬 claim → 加 caveat 的软 claim
82	- 正文数字 → 移入 Appendix
83	
84	---
85	
86	## 三、叙事与 Storytelling
87	
88	### 3.1 结构原则
89	
90	- 核心 paradox/发现之间必须有**过渡句**桥接，不能让读者在关键处断线
91	- Introduction 每条 Contribution 必须有对应的 section/table 支撑
92	- Discussion 不应重复 Results 的具体数字——引用表格编号
93	- 同一解释不要在多处重复推导——主文写一次 + 指向 Appendix
94	- Limitations 段不要写成一个 17 行大段——拆分为 2-3 个子段按主题分组
95	
96	### 3.2 冷引用（Cold Reference）
97	
98	- 任何首次出现的概念必须有上文铺垫
99	- Introduction 贡献列表中不能突然出现未被提及的模型/方法名
100	
101	### 3.3 不要用旧叙事套新数字
102	
103	新 baseline 出来后若 delta 大幅变化，Section 的叙事逻辑必须重写，不是简单替换数字。
104	
105	### 3.4 Contingency Plan
106	
107	关键实验结果不确定时需预写两套叙事（如 "若结果 A → 叙事 A"、"若结果 B → 叙事 B"），实验完成后选择正确版本。提交前必须确认只留了一套。
108	
109	### 3.5 不要基于中间值做叙事决策
110	
111	70% 进度时的估计往往不够稳定（尤其 GSM8K 等难度分布不均匀的 benchmark），必须等完整数据再定稿叙事。
112

116	
117	### 4.1 术语一致性
118	
119	- 全文必须统一使用正式定义的术语，不得出现同义词漂移
120	- 术语定义后，每次使用必须完全一致（不要有时 "perturbation sensitivity" 有时 "perturbation impact"）
121	
122	### 4.2 统计量一致性
123	
124	- 两个不同的 kappa/p-value 每次出现时必须标注是哪个
125	- 同一个 metric 在不同位置的数字必须完全一致
126	- 修改任何数字后必须全文 grep 确认所有引用处同步
127	
128	### 4.3 p-value 格式
129	
130	- 无前导零、3 位小数：`p = .003`（不是 `p = 0.003`）
131	- 当非劣效性 p<0.001 实际由正向效应驱动时，必须加括注说明
132	
133	### 4.4 例子与定义必须一致
134

136

139	## 五、投稿前检查清单（Pre-Submission Checklist）
140	
141	### 5.1 占位符扫描（硬门禁）
142	
143	提交前必须 grep 扫描，以下模式要求**零匹配**：
144	```
145	XX.XX, PLACEHOLDER, [If , TODO, TBD, \placeholder{
146	```
147	所有条件占位段落（`[If ...]`）必须替换为最终文本。
148	
149	### 5.2 编译检查
150	
151	- [ ] 编译零 error
152	- [ ] 无 `??` 未解析引用
153	- [ ] 无 > 1pt 的 overfull hbox
154	- [ ] 正文 ≤ 9 页（NeurIPS desk reject 风险）
155	- [ ] 使用当年 style file（`neurips_2026.sty`）
156	- [ ] Review 版启用行号
157	- [ ] 匿名审稿版无作者姓名、无致谢
158	
159	### 5.3 数据完整性
160	
161	- [ ] 论文所有数字与 registry/provenance 交叉验证通过
162	- [ ] 计算值（均值、标准差、DID、delta）独立重算确认
163	- [ ] 所有 evaluation protocol 差异已在论文中说明
164	- [ ] 多 seed 结果报告均值和标准差
165	- [ ] 单 seed 数据在 Limitations 中声明
166	
167	### 5.4 图表检查
168	
169	- [ ] 所有 figure PDF 存在且路径匹配
170	- [ ] 图表不超栏宽（单栏 5.5in / 全宽 6.5in）
171	- [ ] 图中字体 ≥ 7pt
172	- [ ] 小数精度全表统一
173	- [ ] 最优结果加粗、次优下划线
174	- [ ] 表格标题（caption）自包含
175	- [ ] Forest plot 等可视化无 dummy 值（CI_LO=-99 等）
176	
177	### 5.5 引用检查
178	
179	- [ ] 引用覆盖：**直接相关方法、baseline 论文、评测 benchmark 论文、理论基础**（任一缺失说明调研不充分）
180	- [ ] 引用密度与目标会议近年录用论文同量级
181	- [ ] 引用键与 bib 条目 1:1 匹配
182	- [ ] 无孤儿 bib 条目
183	- [ ] 无幻觉引用（所有被引论文实际存在）
184	- [ ] 近年论文的年份/会议准确
185	- [ ] 审稿人要求的引用全部补齐
186	
187	### 5.6 匿名化检查
188	
189	- [ ] 源代码无硬编码绝对路径（`/Users/...`, `/root/...`）
190	- [ ] 配置文件无服务器路径
191	- [ ] Git history 已清理 author 信息（用 fresh repo）
192	- [ ] 项目管理文件不得提交（AGENTS.md, memory.md, registry.yaml, task_context/ 等）
193	- [ ] API Keys 通过环境变量，无泄露
194	
195	### 5.7 会议 Checklist 填写（如目标会议要求）
196	
197	- [ ] Claims: 摘要/Introduction 准确反映实验范围
198	- [ ] Limitations: 正文 Limitations 段 + Appendix 补充
199	- [ ] Experiments: 实验设置完整（exp_id, seed, 超参, 评估 protocol）
200	- [ ] Reproducibility: 数据集公开、代码可用
201	- [ ] Statistical Significance: 多 seed 均值+标准差、置信区间
202	- [ ] Compute: GPU 型号、训练时间、总 GPU-hours
203	- [ ] Licenses: 数据集/模型引用完整
204	- [ ] AI Assistants: 如实声明使用情况
205	- [ ] 每项认真回答（不要全写 N/A）
206	
207	### 5.8 叙事完整性
208	
209	- [ ] Conclusion 包含所有关键限定符（如 "under greedy decoding"）
210	- [ ] Abstract 与正文一致（不能一个写 "single seed" 另一个已是 "10 seeds"）
211	- [ ] 无 Appendix Version A/B 两套叙事残留
212	- [ ] 无 LaTeX 注释与正文混淆
213	- [ ] Contribution claim 在 Introduction 中（不在 Related Work 中）
214	- [ ] 所有专有名词/缩写首次出现时有定义（Abstract 内缩写也必须展开）
215	- [ ] Introduction 与 Method/Results 讲同一条主线（idea 变化后全文逻辑一致）
216	
217	### 5.9 去 AI 风格检查
218	
219	- [ ] **`grep "—" paper/*.tex` 全文清零**（解释性 em-dash 必须全删，最显著的 AI 痕迹）
220	- [ ] **`grep " – " paper/*.tex` 全文清零**（解释性 en-dash 必须全删）
221	- [ ] 无 "-ing," 分词短语结尾（如 "..., demonstrating the effectiveness of..."）
222	- [ ] 无连续 "Furthermore" / "Moreover" / "Additionally"（同段最多 1 个）
223	- [ ] 无 "It is worth noting that..." / "Notably, ..."
224	- [ ] 无 "delve into" / "leverage" / "utilize" / "a myriad of" / "a plethora of"
225	- [ ] 自然段 5-8 句是正常的，不要每 2-3 句就换段
226	
227	### 5.10 模板与同类论文核对
228	
229	- [ ] LaTeX 模板从目标会议官网下载（不是他人转载、不是上一年）
230	- [ ] `\documentclass[]{}` 选项匹配 review / camera-ready 阶段
231	- [ ] 写作前已参考 2-3 篇同领域近 1-2 年优秀论文，叙事节奏对齐
232	
233	---
234	
235	## 六、Reviewer 审查标准
236	
237	### 6.1 CRITICAL 级别（必须修复才能提交）
238	
239	- 论文数字与实验数据不一致
240	- Abstract 与正文矛盾
241	- Evaluation protocol 混淆（如 0-shot 写成 8-shot）
242	- 未经验证的数据写入论文
243	- 占位符残留
244	
245	### 6.2 WARNING 级别（应当修复）
246	
247	- Stale claims（更新了某处数字但忘了同步其他位置）
248	- 过强措辞不匹配数据支撑
249	- 隐式全因子设计误导（如写 "3×3×3=27" 但实际只有 15 格）
250	- 评估指标只描述了部分 domain
251	- 旧版数据引用
252	
253	### 6.3 数据一致性审查流程
254	
255	1. 从 registry 提取所有实验 metrics
256	2. 对照论文中每一个内联数字（到行号级别）
257	3. 独立重算所有衍生值
258	4. 不一致处标注为 CRITICAL
259	5. 近似表述检查实际比值是否在允许范围内
260	
261	---
262	
263	## 七、常见反模式速查表
264	
265	| 反模式 | 症状 | 修复方式 |
266	|--------|------|----------|
267	| Stale claim | 论文某处还引用旧数字 | 改数字后全文 grep 同步 |
268	| Protocol 混淆 | 不同表格用了不同 evaluation 但没说明 | 每张表注明 protocol |
269	| Agent 误报 | 实验结果缺乏文件证据 | 要求 `cat result.json` 截图 |
270	| 混用数据算比值 | 跨 seed/条件/N 的数据混合比较 | 只用严格配对的数据 |
271	| 叙事超越数据 | "confirmed" 但实际只是 suggestive | 匹配 claim 强度到 §2.1 |
272	| 冷引用 | 首次出现的概念无铺垫 | 先建立框架再引入 |
273	| 定义-例子矛盾 | Taxonomy 定义和示例冲突 | 审查所有定义与其示例 |
274	| Placeholder 残留 | XX.XX, TODO, [If...] 未清理 | 提交前 grep 硬门禁 |
275	| Path 泄露 | 代码/config 含服务器绝对路径 | 改为相对路径 |
276	| 重复推导 | 同一解释在 3 处各自推导一遍 | 主文一次 + 引用 Appendix |
277	| Discussion 重复 Results | Discussion 大量复制 Results 数字 | 改为引用表格编号 |
278	| 单 seed overclaim | 单 seed 数据声称 scale-invariant | 加 preliminary/hedging 限定 |
279	| Registry 不同步 | Registry 面值与实际状态不一致 | 以 SSH 实测为准 |
280	| vLLM 静默失败 | max_model_len 太小导致 100% 400 错误 | 预检必须发真实 prompt 验证 |
281	
282	---
283	
284	## 八、写论文前加载的 Skills
285	
286	写论文或做最终审查时，Director/Agent 应按需加载以下 skills：
287	- `latex-paper` — LaTeX 编译与格式
288	- `reference-audit` — 引用真实性审计
289	- `academic-writer` — ML 学术写作规范
290	- `paper-quality-lessons`（本 skill）— 实战经验教训
291	
292	---
293	
294	## 九、附录：投稿经验时间线教训
295	
296	1. **论文数字锁定时机**：最终编译前 24h 锁定所有数字，之后只允许格式修改
297	2. **GPU 不要空闲**：审稿期间如果 Agent 空闲，应该跑 ablation/扩展实验作为 rebuttal 储备
298	3. **匿名化提前做**：不要等到最后一天才检查路径泄露，fresh repo 需要时间清理
299	4. **9 页零余量策略**：NeurIPS 正文 9 页是硬限，每次新增内容必须等量压缩并编译验证
300	5. **Contingency 叙事提前写**：关键实验完成前就写好两版叙事，避免最后一刻仓促改稿
301

### 2.2 禁止的过强表述

- "confirmed" → 仅 "suggestive" 级别数据不能用
- "scale-invariant" → single-seed 验证不够
- "We attribute X to Y" → 如果是假说，必须改为 "We hypothesize" + "requiring causal verification"
- "roughly twice" → 实际比值必须在 1.8x-2.2x 才能用，否则改为更准确的近似
- "domain-agnostic" → 改为 "robust across N domains tested"

### 2.3 Claim 降级机制

当证据不足以支撑独立 claim 时，应降级为 discussion 中的定性讨论，而非删除。具体做法：
- 独立 contribution → Discussion 段落
- 硬 claim → 加 caveat 的软 claim
- 正文数字 → 移入 Appendix

---

## 三、叙事与 Storytelling

### 3.1 结构原则

- 核心 paradox/发现之间必须有**过渡句**桥接，不能让读者在关键处断线
- Introduction 每条 Contribution 必须有对应的 section/table 支撑
- Discussion 不应重复 Results 的具体数字——引用表格编号
- 同一解释不要在多处重复推导——主文写一次 + 指向 Appendix
- Limitations 段不要写成一个 17 行大段——拆分为 2-3 个子段按主题分组

### 3.2 冷引用（Cold Reference）

- 任何首次出现的概念必须有上文铺垫
- Introduction 贡献列表中不能突然出现未被提及的模型/方法名

### 3.3 不要用旧叙事套新数字

新 baseline 出来后若 delta 大幅变化，Section 的叙事逻辑必须重写，不是简单替换数字。

### 3.4 Contingency Plan

关键实验结果不确定时需预写两套叙事（如 "若结果 A → 叙事 A"、"若结果 B → 叙事 B"），实验完成后选择正确版本。提交前必须确认只留了一套。

### 3.5 不要基于中间值做叙事决策

70% 进度时的估计往往不够稳定（尤其 GSM8K 等难度分布不均匀的 benchmark），必须等完整数据再定稿叙事。

---

## 四、术语与一致性

### 4.1 术语一致性

- 全文必须统一使用正式定义的术语，不得出现同义词漂移
- 术语定义后，每次使用必须完全一致（不要有时 "perturbation sensitivity" 有时 "perturbation impact"）

### 4.2 统计量一致性

- 两个不同的 kappa/p-value 每次出现时必须标注是哪个

- 修改任何数字后必须全文 grep 确认所有引用处同步

### 4.3 p-value 格式

- 无前导零、3 位小数：`p = .003`（不是 `p = 0.003`）
- 当非劣效性 p<0.001 实际由正向效应驱动时，必须加括注说明

### 4.4 例子与定义必须一致

Taxonomy 中的定义和对应示例不能自相矛盾。如果定义说 "no new content"，示例中就不能包含新信息。

\section{Introduction}\label{sec:introduction}

Benchmark contamination, the unintended inclusion of evaluation data in training corpora, poses a growing threat to the integrity of large language model (LLM) evaluation \citep{dodge2021, magar2022, sainz2023}.
As training corpora and public benchmarks both expand, the probability of overlap increases structurally \citep{jacovi2023, chang2024survey}.
When contamination occurs, benchmark scores no longer reflect genuine capability, undermining the primary mechanism by which the community compares and selects models.

A range of detection methods have been proposed, but all require some form of privileged access beyond the binary response record.
N-gram overlap methods need the training corpus \citep{dodge2021, magar2022}.
Membership inference approaches require token-level probabilities \citep{minkprob2024, deng2024}.
Probing methods rely on crafted prompts \citep{golchin2024, oren2024}.
Performance-based methods require multiple test variants or output logits \citep{constat2024, codec2026}.
These methods form a detection frontier ordered by information access.
No existing method operates using only binary response patterns, without model weights, gradients, logits, or training data---though, as we show, effective detection additionally requires externally calibrated item parameters.

In this work, we focus on SFT-stage contamination---where benchmark answers are explicitly included in fine-tuning data---for three reasons.
First, controlled experiments require known ground-truth contamination sets, achievable through fine-tuning with specific benchmark items.
Second, SFT-stage contamination is increasingly relevant as fine-tuning-as-a-service platforms proliferate, creating new pathways for benchmark data to enter training mixtures.
Third, SFT provides a methodologically clean setting to characterize detection boundaries before extending to noisier pretraining scenarios.

The need for detection from binary response patterns grows more pressing as models evolve.
\citet{wang2025fragility} show that all ten log-probability-based methods they evaluate perform at chance level on models trained with reinforcement learning (RL), because RL reshapes internal token distributions while preserving binary correctness patterns.
This motivates a fundamental question: \emph{what can binary response patterns reveal about contamination, and under what conditions?}

We observe that a contaminated LLM is functionally analogous to a test-taker with item preknowledge: both produce response patterns in which difficult items are answered correctly through memorization rather than genuine ability.
This connection points to person-fit statistics, developed over four decades for cheating detection in educational testing \citep{drasgow1985, meijer2001, karabatsos2003, sinharay2017}.
The standardized statistic $\ell_z^*$ \citep{snijders2001} measures how well a response pattern conforms to Item Response Theory (IRT) model predictions.
Figure~\ref{fig:motivation} illustrates this analogy.
Despite the natural correspondence, no prior work has applied person-fit statistics to LLM benchmark contamination.

\begin{figure}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{fig_1_response_pattern.pdf}
  \caption{A clean model's responses track the IRT-predicted probability curve (left); a contaminated model shows anomalous successes on hard items (right, red diamonds), producing a large $|\Delta\ell_z^*|$ signal.}
  \label{fig:motivation}
\end{figure}

Rather than proposing $\ell_z^*$ as a ready-to-deploy detection tool, we characterize the behavior boundaries of IRT person-fit statistics for LLM contamination detection.
Our framework operates at three layers: (i) pre-calibrated 4PL item parameters from the PSN-IRT item bank \citep{psnirt2026}, an external resource derived from 13,000+ models; (ii) binary response patterns obtained from the target model without access to weights or logits; and (iii) retrospective statistical inference requiring no model modification.
Using controlled contamination experiments across three 7--8B model families (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B; $n{=}10$ clean seeds each) with PSN-IRT parameters, we identify three IRT-specific findings on MMLU \citep{hendrycks2021mmlu} and ARC-Challenge:

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*,nosep]
\item \textbf{Model-specific $\theta$-shift dynamics.} Contamination inflates ability estimates ($\hat{\theta}$), absorbing the person-fit signal; $\theta$-anchoring amplifies Qwen's multi-seed $|d|$ by 2.4$\times$ at 50\% contamination while reducing inter-seed CV from 60\% to 19\%, establishing $\theta$-anchoring as a necessary condition for reliable detection of high-ability models at high contamination. ARC-C reverses through a ceiling effect.

\item \textbf{Detection-diagnosis tradeoff.} Simpler statistics yield stronger detection: accuracy $z$-scores produce $|d|$ values several-fold to over an order of magnitude larger than person-fit statistics, and HT generally exceeds $\ell_z^*$. Yet the diagnostic power reverses: only $\ell_z^*$ supports seen/unseen decomposition, mechanistic $\theta$-shift analysis, and sensitivity to response-pattern structure (57/60 vs.\ 4/60 flagged cells on real-world data).

\item \textbf{Non-monotonic dose-response under free-$\theta$ (exploratory).} Multi-seed Qwen trajectory ($|d|$: $4.15 \to 5.36 \to 7.44 \to 5.08$ at 5\%/15\%/25\%/50\%) shows attenuated non-monotonicity; $\theta$-anchoring eliminates the pattern and reveals strong positive dose-response ($|d|{=}12.32$ at 50\%). The non-monotonicity is a $\theta$-estimation artifact, not a detection boundary.
\end{enumerate}

Our contributions are threefold:
(1) We provide the first empirical characterization of IRT person-fit behavior for LLM contamination, quantifying theoretically predicted phenomena ($\theta$-shift absorption, detection-diagnosis tradeoff) whose magnitudes and boundary conditions are not derivable from IRT theory alone.
(2) We establish that $\Delta\ell_z^*$ reliably detects SFT-stage contamination across three model families (all bootstrap 95\% CIs exclude zero, $n{=}10$).
(3) We document the detection-diagnosis tradeoff, clarifying what binary response patterns can and cannot reveal.
Findings~1--2 are confirmatory (pre-planned 15\%/50\% $\times$ 3 families); Finding~3 is exploratory (5\%/25\% added post-hoc).

1	\section{Method}
2	\label{sec:method}
3	
4	\subsection{IRT Person-Fit Framework}
5	\label{sec:framework}
6	
7	We adopt the four-parameter logistic (4PL) IRT model to characterize contamination-induced aberrance in LLM response patterns.
8	The 4PL model defines the probability that a model with ability $\theta$ answers item $i$ correctly:
9	\begin{equation}
10	  P_i(\theta) = c_i + (d_i - c_i)\,\frac{1}{1 + e^{-a_i(\theta - b_i)}}
11	  \label{eq:4pl}
12	\end{equation}
13	where $a_i$ is discrimination, $b_i$ difficulty, $c_i$ the lower asymptote (guessing), and $d_i$ the upper asymptote (slip).
14	Item parameters are pre-calibrated by PSN-IRT \citep{psnirt2026} from a large-scale leaderboard dataset; we use these external parameters rather than re-estimating from potentially contaminated data, since our MML-EM refit shows discrimination recovery degrades to $r_a{=}0.127$ on contaminated leaderboard data.
15	
16	Given item parameters and a binary response vector $\mathbf{x} = (x_1, \ldots, x_n)$, we compute the person-fit statistic $\ell_z^*$ \citep{snijders2001}, a standardized log-likelihood residual quantifying deviation between observed and expected response patterns.
17	The Snijders correction accounts for estimation uncertainty in $\hat{\theta}_{\text{MLE}}$, so that $\ell_z^* \sim \mathcal{N}(0,1)$ under the null \citep{drasgow1985, snijders2001}; \citet{magis2012} provide a detailed treatment of how response model selection and ability estimation affect $\ell_z^*$.
18	Large negative $\ell_z^*$ indicates aberrant responding (unexpected failures on easy items or unexpected successes on hard items); large positive values indicate over-consistent patterns.
19	
20	\subsection{$\Delta\ell_z^*$ Matched-Difference Design}
21	\label{sec:did}
22	
23	LLM response patterns systematically violate IRT assumptions of local independence and unidimensionality.
24	In our empirical data, 57 of 60 model-benchmark cells yield $|\ell_z^*| > 1.96$ even absent contamination, rendering absolute thresholds uninformative.
25	We address this through a matched-difference design.
26	
27	For controlled experiments with clean baselines, we compute:
28	\begin{equation}
29	  \Delta\ell_z^* = \ell_{z,\text{contam}}^{*} - \bar{\ell}_{z,\text{clean}}^{*}
30	  \label{eq:delta_lz}
31	\end{equation}
32	where $\bar{\ell}_{z,\text{clean}}^{*}$ averages over $n{=}10$ clean seeds.
33	The shared model misfit cancels, isolating contamination-specific aberrance.
34	We quantify effect sizes as $d = (\ell_{z,\text{contam}}^{*} - \bar{\ell}_{z,\text{clean}}^{*})\,/\,s_{\text{clean}}$, where $s_{\text{clean}}$ is the SD of the $n{=}10$ clean-seed $\ell_z^*$ values; with a single contaminated observation per condition, $d$ is a standardized departure rather than a two-sample effect size (Hedges' $g = J \cdot d$, $J \approx 0.914$ for $n{=}10$; \citealp{hedges1981}).
35	We report percentile bootstrap 95\% CIs (10,000 resamples) reflecting clean-seed variability only; BCa correction (Appendix~\ref{app:bca}) generally confirms conservative coverage; multi-seed contamination-run variance appears in Appendix~\ref{app:reproducibility}.
36	
37	For deployment without clean baselines, cross-benchmark comparison provides the reference: the target benchmark's $\ell_z^*$ is compared against benchmarks presumed clean from the same model.
38	Significance thresholds derive from a nonparametric bootstrap null rather than the asymptotic $\mathcal{N}(0,1)$ reference, accommodating residual model misspecification.
39	Simulation analysis (Appendix~\ref{app:local_dep}) confirms that the matched-difference design is robust to local dependence at realistic levels ($d_{\text{ratio}} \geq 0.93$ for $\sigma_\tau \leq 0.5$) and maintains ${\geq}98.5\%$ power even under contamination-specific asymmetric dependence.
40	
41	\subsection{Experimental Setup}
42	\label{sec:setup}
43	
44	\paragraph{Models and contamination.}
45	We validate on three 7--8B model families: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3.
46	Each is fine-tuned with QLoRA (rank\,$=$\,16, $\alpha$\,$=$\,32; full hyperparameters in Appendix~\ref{app:hyperparams}) under clean and contaminated conditions at varying levels: at $X\%$ contamination, $X\%$ of SFT training examples are benchmark items (questions paired with gold answers in the standard evaluation format), with the remainder drawn from a general instruction-following dataset.
47	All three families are tested at 15\% and 50\% contamination.
48	Following initial observation of non-monotonic dose-response for Qwen, we added 5\% and 25\% conditions for Qwen to trace the full dose-response curve.
49	Contamination subsets are nested (5\% $\subset$ 15\% $\subset$ 25\% $\subset$ 50\%) using a fixed item-selection seed; a robustness check with an alternative seed confirms consistent $\ell_z^*$ values (Appendix~\ref{app:reproducibility}).
50	The 25\% condition was subsequently extended to Llama to test whether the pattern generalizes; Mistral was not tested at 5\% or 25\% due to computational constraints.
51	We train $n{=}10$ independent clean seeds per model to establish baseline variability and construct bootstrap confidence intervals.
52	Reported CIs reflect variability across $n$ clean baseline seeds; for Qwen, each contamination level (15\%/25\%/50\%) was additionally replicated with $n{=}3$ independent QLoRA seeds to assess training-run variance (Appendix~\ref{app:reproducibility}).
53	
54	\paragraph{Benchmarks.}
55	We evaluate on MMLU \citep{hendrycks2021mmlu} (14,042 items) and ARC-Challenge \citep{clark2018arc} (295 items), spanning two orders of magnitude in benchmark size.
56	All 4PL item parameters are from \citet{psnirt2026}.
57	ARC-Challenge experiments were conducted on Qwen only, as the primary evaluation of cross-benchmark generalizability; extending to additional families was constrained by computational budget.
58	
59	\paragraph{Post-RL extension.}
60	To probe behavior boundaries beyond SFT, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO; \citealp{shao2024}) to one contaminated Qwen model (15\% MMLU) for 1,500 steps, evaluating at three checkpoints.
61	This extension is $N{=}1$ (single model family, single contamination level).
62	
63	\paragraph{Contamination model.}
64	QLoRA SFT on benchmark items serves as a controlled proxy for SFT-stage contamination, where benchmark data is explicitly included in fine-tuning mixtures---analogous to a test-taker with item preknowledge.
65	We refer to the contaminated benchmark items as \emph{seen items} and the remaining benchmark items not included in training as \emph{unseen items}; this partition enables decomposition of person-fit statistics to assess whether the contamination signal concentrates on memorized items (\S\ref{sec:degradation}).
66	Our findings are scoped to SFT-based contamination and may not generalize to pretraining contamination, which operates through different learning dynamics.
67

Contamination raises overall accuracy, which inflates $\hat{\theta}_{\text{MLE}}$; a higher $\hat{\theta}$ ``explains away'' anomalous successes on hard items, absorbing the contamination signal into the ability estimate.

The small item count amplifies this concentration, producing a disproportionately large $\ell_z^*$ shift per contaminated item.

1	\section{Discussion}\label{sec:discussion}
2	
3	Our findings reveal both the strengths and boundaries of IRT person-fit for contamination detection: $\ell_z^*$ reliably detects SFT-stage contamination across model families, but three boundary conditions constrain its practical utility.
4	
5	\paragraph{Characterization over tool.}
6	The detection-diagnosis tradeoff (\S\ref{sec:degradation}) shows that simpler statistics detect contamination more powerfully than $\ell_z^*$: accuracy $z$-scores yield $|d|$ values several-fold to over an order of magnitude larger, and HT generally exceeds $\ell_z^*$.
7	The value of the IRT framework lies not in detection power but in mechanistic understanding: the $\theta$-shift analysis reveals \emph{why} detection sensitivity varies across models and contamination levels, the seen/unseen decomposition identifies \emph{what fraction} of items are memorized, and the 4PL parameterization captures item-level ceiling effects that 3PL misattributes as aberrance.
8	These diagnostics are invisible to accuracy $z$-scores or HT; our contribution lies in quantifying these theoretically predictable effects in the LLM setting, where magnitudes and boundary conditions are not derivable from theory alone.
9	
10	\paragraph{Practical implications.}
11	Two results have immediate consequences.
12	Free-$\theta$ estimation produces seed-dependent dose-response curves (CV up to 60\%); $\theta$-anchoring stabilizes detection for models whose clean $\ell_z^*$ departs substantially from zero.
13	$\ell_z^*$ is most informative for large benchmarks ($n \approx 8{,}000$ items for 80\% power at 15\% contamination); on small benchmarks like ARC-C, detection relies on concentrated contamination effects.
14	
15	\paragraph{Scope and calibration.}
16	Universal baseline misfit (57/60 cells flagged) confirms systematic IRT violations; the $\Delta\ell_z^*$ design turns this into a feature through within-model differencing.
17	PSN-IRT provides pre-calibrated 4PL parameters \citep{psnirt2026}, but classical calibration fails on contaminated data ($r_a{=}0.127$; Appendix~\ref{app:mml_em}); the robustness analysis (Appendix~\ref{app:param_perturb}) provides partial reassurance (${\pm}10\%$ noise tolerance).
18	\paragraph{Information requirements and method positioning.}
19	$\ell_z^*$ sits below MIA \citep[logits;][]{minkprob2024} and ConStat \citep[multi-benchmark scores;][]{constat2024} in an information-requirements hierarchy, needing only single-benchmark binary patterns and an external item bank---suited to retrospective audits where logits are unavailable. Our GRPO pilot confirms this: Min-K\% AUC drops to chance ($0.493$) post-RL while $\ell_z^*$ signal persists (${\sim}3.3$; Figure~\ref{fig:grpo}), consistent with \citet{wang2025fragility}.

126	\section{Baseline $\ell_z^*$ Interpretation}
127	\label{app:baseline_meaning}
128	
129	The baseline $\ell_z^*$ value reflects a model's difficulty-ordering consistency under the 4PL model, not its accuracy alone.
130	In the PSN-IRT leaderboard data (12 models $\times$ 5 benchmarks, distinct from our controlled experiments), Mistral ($\text{acc}{=}0.514$, lowest among the 12 models) exhibits $\ell_z^*{=}{+}5.42$ (second highest), because its response pattern follows the IRT-predicted difficulty ordering more closely than higher-accuracy models whose responses violate the assumed item structure.

170	\subsection{$\Delta\ell_z^*$ Under Local Dependence}
171	\label{app:local_dep}
172	
173	IRT person-fit statistics assume local independence---conditional on $\theta$, item responses are independent.
174	LLM benchmarks violate this assumption through topical clustering (e.g., MMLU subjects); resampling-based approaches can provide valid person-fit assessment even under such violations \citep{sinharay2016}.
175	We evaluate whether the $\Delta\ell_z^*$ matched-difference design is robust to local dependence (LD) via two simulation scenarios on 14,042 MMLU items with 1,000 replications each.
176	
177	\paragraph{Shared LD.}
178	Clean and contaminated conditions share identical testlet structure (${\sim}200$ testlets of ${\sim}70$ items, random effect $\gamma_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_\tau)$).

218	\subsection{Sensitivity to Item Parameter Estimation Error}
219	\label{app:param_perturb}
220	
221	PSN-IRT item parameters carry estimation error from the calibration sample.
222	We evaluate detection sensitivity by adding joint noise to all four parameters: multiplicative perturbation $p' = p \cdot (1 + \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma))$ for $a$, $c$, and $d$; additive perturbation $b' = b + \sigma \cdot \mathcal{N}(0, 1)$ for difficulty.
223	Tables~\ref{tab:param_noise_free} and \ref{tab:param_noise_fixed} report results over 100 trials using Qwen MMLU response vectors.

225	Detection of 15\% contamination is robust to parameter noise under free-$\theta$ (17.4\% bias at $\sigma{=}10\%$, $|d|$ still ${>}5$; Table~\ref{tab:param_noise_free}).
226	The 50\% contamination condition under free-$\theta$ is fragile---consistent with its already-weak signal due to $\theta$-shift absorption (\S\ref{sec:inverted_u}).

265	\section{BCa Bootstrap Sensitivity Check}
266	\label{app:bca}
267	
268	As a sensitivity check, we computed bias-corrected and accelerated (BCa) bootstrap confidence intervals for all Cohen's $d$ estimates.
269	BCa CIs were uniformly narrower than the percentile CIs reported in the main text (mean reduction 22\%), confirming that our reported intervals are conservative.

276	With 14,042 MMLU items and an examinee-to-item ratio of $N{:}J = 0.013$---far below the $N{>}500$ typically required for stable 3PL estimation---discrimination parameters are severely under-determined.

300	\section{Post-RL Preliminary Observation}
301	\label{app:post_rl}
302	
303	\citet{wang2025fragility} show that all MIA-based detectors fail after RL post-training.
304	In a single-model pilot ($N{=}1$, Qwen, GRPO), we applied GRPO \citep{shao2024} for 1,500 steps to a contaminated model (15\% MMLU) and evaluated at three checkpoints.
305	GRPO erases the accuracy gap between seen and unseen items ($11.4\text{pp} \to 2.1\text{pp}$), but the $\ell_z^*$ response-pattern gap persists (${\sim}3.3$; Figure~\ref{fig:grpo}), suggesting structural traces of contamination may survive RL alignment.
306	Min-K\% membership inference confirms this dissociation: while SFT yields a weak MIA signal (AUC-ROC${=}0.611$), GRPO training drives AUC to $0.493$ (step~500), $0.493$ (step~1000), and $0.493$ (step~1500)---indistinguishable from random chance ($0.50$) as RL erases memorization-based features while the response-pattern anomaly that $\ell_z^*$ detects persists.
